knobs.name: teach
knobs.note: Ask the wall's own song library before Shazam. It learns the songs Shazam misses from their iTunes previews, and from the room.

knobs.name: teach_by_ear
knobs.note: Also learn a song the way this room hears it, from the microphone, while another source names it. Fingerprints only, never audio.

knobs.name: teach_match_score
knobs.note: How many aligned landmarks make a match against the wall's own library. Lower names sooner and risks a wrong song; a real match scores in the dozens.

games.name: wordle
games.title: Wordle
games.blurb: Six guesses at a five-letter word. Say it or type it.

games.name: sudoku
games.title: Sudoku
games.blurb: The grid on the wall, the digits from the phone. Easy, medium or hard.

games.name: connections
games.title: Connections
games.blurb: Sixteen words, four groups of four. Four mistakes allowed.

games.name: spellingbee
games.title: Spelling Bee
games.blurb: Seven letters, one in the middle. Say words of four or more.

games.name: letterboxed
games.title: Letter Boxed
games.blurb: Twelve letters round a square. Chain words until all are used.

games.name: strands
games.title: Strands
games.blurb: A grid of letters hiding a themed set. Say a word; the wall lights its path.

games.name: crossword
games.title: Mini crossword
games.blurb: Five by five. Clues on the phone, answers by voice or by typing.

games.name: contexto
games.title: Contexto
games.blurb: Guess the secret word by meaning. Every guess gets a rank.

games.name: sliding
games.title: Sliding puzzle
games.blurb: A sleeve you have played, in blocks. Slide them back.

games.name: reveal
games.title: Cover reveal
games.blurb: A sleeve sharpens over thirty seconds. First to name it wins.

games.name: heardle
games.title: Heardle
games.blurb: A song you have played, a second at a time. Name it in six.

games.name: quiz
games.title: Pub quiz
games.blurb: Ten questions on a theme. Twenty seconds each. Scores on the wall.

games.name: pictionary
games.title: AI pictionary
games.blurb: The wall draws a secret word. Guess it in sixty seconds.

games.name: twentyq
games.title: Twenty questions
games.blurb: Think of a thing. The wall asks; knock for yes, whistle for no.

games.name: reaction
games.title: Reaction knock
games.blurb: Red, then green: knock. The milliseconds on the panel. Five rounds.

games.name: whistlebird
games.title: Whistle bird
games.blurb: Whistle high to climb, low to dive, through the gaps.

games.name: pong
games.title: Pong
games.blurb: Your phone is the paddle: tilt it. First to seven.

games.name: snake
games.title: Snake
games.blurb: The phone is the remote. Eat, grow, do not hit the wall.

games.name: tetris
games.title: Tetris
games.blurb: The phone is the remote: left, right, rotate, drop.
